# SEmptyState `<s-empty-state>`

```ts
import { SEmptyState } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string` | The heading of the EmptyState. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `graphic` | An illustration or symbol shown above the heading. Accepts a single `Image` or `Icon`, either directly or as the only child of a wrapping element. |
| `primary-action` | The main call to action, rendered below the text content. Accepts a single `Button` with a `variant` of `primary`; anything else is ignored with a development warning. |
| `secondary-actions` | An alternative action, rendered beside the primary one. Accepts a single `Button` with a `variant` of `secondary` or `auto` — despite the plural name, only one is rendered. |
| `subheading` | Supporting text below the heading, explaining what's missing or what to do next. Accepts `Text` and `Link` components. |
